g.text: FINAL · Source inference on an independent synthetic transport challenge
Regions condition on a single source; two-source coverage is descriptive. Old point sets have no geographic coverage/area.
MAP grid resolutions differ. 400 condition-worlds / 40 seed blocks; old 40/40 weather cases refused; new 40/40 weather cases refused. No field validation.
